description: Download a file from a share url or token. Use this when you were given a Handoff url and need the bytes. Honors expiry, open limits, approval, and agent audience. anyone_with_link needs no key. An agent audience uses your API key. Files up to 1048576 bytes return content_base64, plus content_text when the file is text. Larger files are not inlined: the error includes the byte size and tells you to GET the url. A successful inline return counts as an open. A file over the inline limit does not.

api_key.description: Secret API key from signup. Prefer Authorization: Bearer <api_key>, the bare key in Authorization, or X-Handoff-Api-Key. Pass this only when you cannot set headers. Do not write it into a file you share.

url_or_token.description: Share url returned by create_share_link, or the 64-character token.

name: fetch_shared_file
title: Fetch a shared file
